title: What's New: Value Chain Automation with Production Orders (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Sustainability Value Entries and Document Flow
Default Values and Production Order Setup
Item Cards and Purchase Invoice Integration
Production Order Posting and Sustainability Entries
Finished Goods and Value Chain Completion

features.name: Sustainability Value Entries
features.description: New functionality to track sustainability value entries similar to costing methods for items. System collects emissions information when posting purchase documents and tracks changes through transfer orders, assembly orders, and production orders.
features.status_evidence_quote: value chain completely functionality is in public preview in this moment
caveats: Item charges not supported in this wave
No print out for final gas emissions in this wave

features.name: Value Chain Tracking
features.description: Sustainability setup feature that enables automatic collection and tracking of emissions from items and work machine centers through production documents. When enabled, system automatically calculates carbon equivalent in background based on emissions configuration.
features.status_evidence_quote: value chain completely functionality is in public preview in this moment
caveats: Requires sandbox testing before production use
Replenishment system must not be purchase for automatic calculation

features.name: Item Emissions on Item Cards
features.description: New fields on item card to display and enter emissions data including carbon, methane, and other environmental metrics. Users can manually enter emission values and run calculate carbon equivalent to establish default values for production.
features.status_evidence_quote: value chain completely functionality is in public preview in this moment
caveats: Manual entry only available if replenishment policy is purchase
Calculate carbon equivalent must be run manually on first setup

features.name: Work Center Emissions
features.description: New sustainability fast tab on work centers to enter and track emissions data. System collects these emissions and moves them to production order routings. Users can run calculate carbon equivalent for single or all work centers.
features.status_evidence_quote: value chain completely functionality is in public preview in this moment
caveats: Calculate CO2E must be run manually on first setup

features.name: Production Order Carbon Equivalent Tracking
features.description: Production orders now display total carbon equivalent based on production BOM materials and routing information. System automatically refreshes and calculates sustainability account and total carbon equivalent when refresh production order is run.
features.status_evidence_quote: value chain completely functionality is in public preview in this moment
caveats: Total carbon equivalent starts empty until refresh production order is executed

features.name: Production Journal Emissions Posting
features.description: Production journal, consumption journal, and output journal can now post emissions. Consumption records item consumption emissions, output records finished goods emissions, production journal records combination of both.
features.status_evidence_quote: value chain completely functionality is in public preview in this moment
caveats: Only works with average costing method

features.name: Production BOM Sustainability Setup
features.description: Production BOMs now display carbon equivalent per unit field that shows emissions collected from source items. Field is hidden if value chain tracking is not enabled, maintaining normal user experience.
features.status_evidence_quote: value chain completely functionality is in public preview in this moment
caveats: Must manually run calculate CO2E on first creation when enabling functionality
System works automatically after initial setup

features.name: Routing Emissions Tracking
features.description: Routings now display carbon equivalent per unit field that collects emissions from work machine centers. Similar to production BOM, this requires manual calculate CO2E on first setup.
features.status_evidence_quote: value chain completely functionality is in public preview in this moment
caveats: Must manually run calculate CO2E on first creation

features.name: Capacity Ledger Entry Sustainability Link
features.description: Capacity ledger entry now includes a new sustainability account column that links to sustainability value entries. Other emission details are stored in the sustainability value entries rather than capacity ledger entry.
features.status_evidence_quote: value chain completely functionality is in public preview in this moment
